retained_dataset.license_or_use_basis: Two cited scalar transfer values and two cited Figiel water targets retained for reproducible scholarly validation with attribution; no source paper bytes are redistributed.
retained_dataset.tolerance_rationale: Source transforms are checked to 1e-12 kJ/mol; this is an identity check, not a scientific acceptance cutoff.

water_reference.source: Figiel, Yu, and Held (2025), retained Table S5 regression target ledger
water_reference.license_or_use_basis: Repository-retained cited scalar regression targets reused with attribution for a bounded validation transform.

transfer_sources.citation: Gritzner and Auinger (2009), Acta Chimica Slovenica 56, 86-94
transfer_sources.license_or_use_basis: Cited scalar extracted for scholarly validation; source PDF is linked but not redistributed.
transfer_sources.scale_decision: The table reports molar transfer Gibbs energies but does not make the concentration-scale convention explicit; treating it as the c-process value is a declared working assumption.
transfer_sources.pressure_convention: Standard-state transfer quantity; source pressure is not a model-input pressure for this regression.

transfer_sources.citation: Sakamoto and Okazaki (1987), Bulletin of the Faculty of Education, Shimane University 21, 81-86
transfer_sources.license_or_use_basis: Cited scalar extracted for scholarly validation; source PDF is linked but not redistributed.
transfer_sources.scale_decision: The potentiometric source reports concentrations in mol/dm3; the value is treated as a c-process transfer Gibbs energy.
transfer_sources.pressure_convention: Standard-state transfer quantity; source pressure is not a model-input pressure for this regression.

standard_state_conversion.butanol_density_source: NIST-hosted measured density compilation at 298.15 K
standard_state_conversion.butanol_density_use_basis: One cited measured density used only in the declared standard-state conversion; source PDF is not redistributed.

claim_boundary: Each ion has one transformed in-sample target and one fitted coordinate. The fit supplies local rank evidence only; it has no held-out, practical-identifiability, uncertainty, predictive, or authority claim.
